```{r cars}
# =============================================
# STEP 1: CREATE PACKAGE STRUCTURE
# =============================================

# Install required packages if not already installed
if (!require("devtools")) install.packages("devtools")
if (!require("roxygen2")) install.packages("roxygen2")
if (!require("readxl")) install.packages("readxl")

# Create package directory
pkg_name <- "DataTransSimple"
pkg_path <- file.path(getwd(), pkg_name)

if (dir.exists(pkg_path)) unlink(pkg_path, recursive = TRUE)

dir.create(pkg_path)
dir.create(file.path(pkg_path, "R"))
dir.create(file.path(pkg_path, "man"), recursive = TRUE)

# =============================================
# STEP 2: WRITE DESCRIPTION FILE
# =============================================

desc_content <- 'Package: DataTransSimple
Type: Package
Title: Simple Data Transformation and Aggregation
Version: 1.0.0
Author: alyMAMA Ali Alsenani
Maintainer: Your Name <your.email@example.com>
Description: Provides functions for data transformation and aggregation.
License: GPL-3
Imports: stats
Suggests: testthat
Encoding: UTF-8
'

writeLines(desc_content, file.path(pkg_path, "DESCRIPTION"))

# =============================================
# STEP 3: WRITE R FUNCTIONS (with roxygen comments)
# =============================================

# Function 1: Logarithmic Transformation
log_transform <- function(x) {
  if (any(x <= 0)) stop("Values must be positive for log transformation.")
  log(x)
}

# Function 2: Box-Cox Transformation
boxcox_transform <- function(x, lambda = 0) {
  if (any(x <= 0)) stop("Values must be positive for Box-Cox transformation.")
  if (lambda == 0) {
    return(log(x))
  } else {
    return((x^lambda - 1) / lambda)
  }
}

# Function 3: Min-Max Normalization
minmax_normalization <- function(x) {
  (x - min(x, na.rm = TRUE)) / (max(x, na.rm = TRUE) - min(x, na.rm = TRUE))
}

# Function 4: Z-Score Standardization
zscore_transform <- function(x) {
  (x - mean(x, na.rm = TRUE)) / sd(x, na.rm = TRUE)
}

# Function 5: Polynomial Transformation
polynomial_transform <- function(x, degree = 2) {
  if (degree < 1) stop("Degree must be >= 1")
  sapply(0:degree, function(d) x^d)
}

# Function 6: Weighted Aggregation
weighted_aggregation <- function(x, weights) {
  if (length(x) != length(weights)) stop("x and weights must be same length")
  weighted_sum <- sum(x * weights, na.rm = TRUE)
  weighted_avg <- weighted_sum / sum(weights, na.rm = TRUE)
  list(weighted_sum = weighted_sum, weighted_avg = weighted_avg)
}

# Function 7: Moving Average
moving_average <- function(x, window_size) {
  if (window_size < 1) stop("Window size must be >= 1")
  stats::filter(x, rep(1/window_size, window_size), sides = 1)
}

# Save all functions to R directory
func_list <- list(
  log_transform, boxcox_transform, minmax_normalization,
  zscore_transform, polynomial_transform, weighted_aggregation, moving_average
)

for (func in func_list) {
  func_name <- deparse(substitute(func))
  writeLines(deparse(func), file.path(pkg_path, "R", paste0(func_name, ".R")))
}

# =============================================
# STEP 4: CREATE NAMESPACE FILE
# =============================================

namespace_content <- '# Generated by roxygen2: do not edit by hand

export(boxcox_transform)
export(log_transform)
export(minmax_normalization)
export(moving_average)
export(polynomial_transform)
export(weighted_aggregation)
export(zscore_transform)
'

writeLines(namespace_content, file.path(pkg_path, "NAMESPACE"))

# =============================================
# STEP 5: INSTALL PACKAGE
# =============================================

devtools::document(pkg_path)
devtools::install(pkg_path)

# =============================================
# STEP 6: TEST PACKAGE WITH TURBINE DATA
# =============================================

library(readxl)
library(DataTransSimple)

# Load turbine data (adjust path if needed)
turbine_data <- read_excel("turbine_thrust.XLS")
print("Turbine Data Head:")
print(head(turbine_data))

# Test each transformation on column y (thrust)
y <- turbine_data$y

cat("\n=== Testing Transformations ===\n")

# 1. Box-Cox (fails if y <= 0)
tryCatch({
  bc <- boxcox_transform(y, lambda = 0.5)
  cat("Box-Cox (lambda=0.5) first 5:", head(bc, 5), "\n")
}, error = function(e) cat("Box-Cox Error:", e$message, "\n"))

# 2. Log (fails if y <= 0)
tryCatch({
  lg <- log_transform(y)
  cat("Log transform first 5:", head(lg, 5), "\n")
}, error = function(e) cat("Log Error:", e$message, "\n"))

# 3. Min-Max
mm <- minmax_normalization(y)
cat("Min-Max first 5:", head(mm, 5), "\n")

# 4. Z-Score
zs <- zscore_transform(y)
cat("Z-Score first 5:", head(zs, 5), "\n")

# 5. Polynomial (degree=2)
poly <- polynomial_transform(y, degree = 2)
cat("Polynomial (degree 2) first row:", poly[1, ], "\n")

# 6. Weighted Aggregation
weights <- rep(1, length(y))
wag <- weighted_aggregation(y, weights)
cat("Weighted Sum:", wag$weighted_sum, "\n")
cat("Weighted Avg:", wag$weighted_avg, "\n")

# 7. Moving Average (window=3)
ma <- moving_average(y, window_size = 3)
cat("Moving Average (window=3) first 5:", head(ma, 5), "\n")

# =============================================
# STEP 7: GENERATE REPORT
# =============================================

cat("\n=== PACKAGE TESTING REPORT ===\n")
cat("Package Name: DataTransSimple\n")
cat("Functions Implemented: 7\n")
cat("Test Dataset: turbine_thrust.XLS (n =", nrow(turbine_data), "rows)\n")
cat("Variables in dataset:", paste(names(turbine_data), collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("Tested on column: y (Turbine Thrust)\n")
cat("All functions executed successfully except where noted.\n")
cat("Package is ready for use in regression preprocessing.\n")
```
